amendment: Post-hoc interface-repair follow-up to v1; original v1 outcomes are immutable. The original v1 rejected 6 of 8 first candidates as invalid restricted source and failed to use the second allowed attempt. V2 explicitly returns AST validator errors, retains source for feedback, and uses the same second-attempt opportunity for both arms. Not a blind trial.

policy_arms.baseline: Generate a fresh independent implementation from the same bug report and the same measured public feedback
policy_arms.nykra: Revise the selected parent implementation using the same measured public feedback

training_feedback: up to 3 failing public examples plus deterministic AST validation error category, identical availability to both arms
heldout_access: only after final best-by-training candidate selection; no prompts include hidden cases
primary_outcome: per-arm fraction of four tasks passing all 32 heldout tests
notes: All four tasks reused without cherry-picking after v1. Small, post-hoc, nonblinded, not statistically conclusive, function-level repairs rather than real GitHub issues.
